# Read the SF Mono dmg without mounting it

`brew install sfmono-square` has been failing since 2026-09-09 with:

```
hdiutil: attach failed - Device not configured
```

Homebrew [now denies `mach-lookup` in the build sandbox][brew-sandbox], and `hdiutil attach`
cannot reach the Mach services it needs to attach a disk image. Apple ships SF Mono in a dmg,
and that is the command Homebrew unpacks a dmg with, so every build died while staging the font,
on every machine, not only in CI.

[brew-sandbox]: https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/commit/0190b03e5fe7cc0f2d83c1211ba2e9f4b97ff6ee

The dmg is now staged as it is (`using: :nounzip`) and read with `7zz`, which walks the HFS+ image
in userland and mounts nothing. `sevenzip` is a new build dependency.

Nothing about the fonts changed. The dmg is byte for byte the one v3.5.0 built from
(`6d4a0b78...`, last modified 2025-07-10), and the `SF Mono Fonts.pkg` that `7zz` pulls out of it
has the same SHA-256 as the one `hdiutil` used to hand over. No codepoint, glyph or metric is
touched.
